name: docket-tracker
description: Single-plugin marketplace for docket-tracker: scaffold and maintain a file-driven Next.js litigation tracker for any federal case, fed by CourtListener.

plugins.name: docket-tracker
plugins.description: Scaffold and maintain a reproducible, file-driven Next.js litigation-tracker website for any federal case. Pulls docket data from CourtListener, classifies filing importance, tracks RECAP/PDF availability, and drafts a verifiable legal-narrative layer for the user to review. Provides /docket-tracker:new (scaffold a new tracker) and /docket-tracker:sync (refresh an existing one).
